|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Apology Accepted (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V9-D-apologyaccepted-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image or errata-sheet slip; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-apologyaccepted022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/apologyaccepted.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Dark/large/apologyaccepted.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Apology Accepted”. Text: “During battle, lose an Imperial leader piloting your Star Destroyer. For remainder of turn, that Star Destroyer draws 2 battle destiny if unable to otherwise, is immune to attrition, and its power may not be increased by Imperial pilots aboard (except Vader).”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Apology Accepted (V) (Errata)]]): PC card image uploaded 10 July 2022<ref name="img-apologyaccepted6489b69">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Dark/large/apologyaccepted.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 commit 6489b69] (10 July 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual9-Dark/large/apologyaccepted.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Apology Accepted”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “During battle, lose an Imperial leader piloting your Star Destroyer. For remainder of turn, that Star Destroyer draws 2 battle destiny if unable to otherwise, is immune to attrition, and its power may not be increased by Imperial pilots aboard (except Vader).”
